# Vendored Markdown parser

markdown-it 15.0.2, MIT license.

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.2.tgz

Registry SHA-512 integrity: `sha512-q4IGxMv56jCqT4OCRCADBoDP3LO4MhmTXjFbphHPXs4g3j9Xg5RDnxqN8IF/3vIWEU+VCnUq+7JUg/cfy2E6Qw==`

Locally served browser UMD bundle; no CDN or runtime package installation. Raw HTML and typographic rewriting are disabled in web/markdown.js. Update bundle, license and integrity together.

The upstream MIT notice is prepended to the distributed minified bundle, so users receiving the script receive its license notice too. The package archive integrity above covers the unmodified npm archive.
